result.title: Shared information governs multi-view planted matching
result.comment: 139 pages, 4 figures. Ancillary files contain the scripts and tables for the computer-assisted proofs
result.summary: We study when the rows of $K$ shuffled views of the same $n$ objects can be matched, where each object is observed once in every view through a Gaussian feature vector with known covariance. For every fixed $K$, all views can be matched up to $o(n)$ errors if the shared information $J$ of one object's $K$ observations exceeds $(1+ε)\log n$, and not if it is below $(1-ε)\log n$; this can hold although no two views can be matched on their own. Below the threshold, two views can still be matched if some set of views containing both has shared information above $\log n$; otherwise every estimator, even one that reads all views, has vanishing overlap between them. Matching every row is governed by the weakest bipartition of the views: with weak correlations the threshold is $2\log n$ for the mutual information across it. For a weak common signal observed through independent noise, the two thresholds are $4/K$ and $4/(K-1)$ in units of $\sum_\ellρ_\ell^2/\log n$, which answers a question of Wee, Yang, Fan and Mao. Beyond weak correlations the bipartition condition is not sufficient: rare subpopulations impose a Rényi condition for every partition into at least three blocks. We conjecture that the two conditions together characterize exact recovery for Gaussian laws, and prove this for three views with equal correlations and in several further cases, in part with computer assistance. With equal correlations, layered screening attains $4/K$ for $K=3,4$ in $O(Kn^2d)$ operations, and for general laws a recursive decoder attains $J$. The almost-exact thresholds extend to known product laws and to objects observed in random subsets of the views.

AI.brief_summary: 研究同一批 n 个对象经 K 个打乱视图（每个对象每视图各观测一次、高斯特征）观测时行匹配何时可行，给出以共享信息 J 相对 log n 为界的几乎精确阈值，刻画决定整体匹配的「最弱二分割」与稀有子群带来的 Rényi 条件，并给出分层筛选与递归解码两种达到阈值的算法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多个视图的共享信息何时足以唯一定位同一实体」的阈值分析，可能为多视图视觉证据聚合与跨视图实体对齐提供理论参照；分层筛选与递归解码中按子集选择性利用视图的结构，也可供核查 LVR 中证据筛选与计算成本的关系。
